task_groups.title: Implement repository resolution and authorization enforcement

subtasks.title: Implement workspace resolver: extract org/slug from URL and validate against DB
details: Create `internal/gitserver/resolver.go` with a `resolveWorkspace(ctx echo.Context, db *sql.DB) (*Workspace, error)` function
Extract `:org` and `:slug` path parameters from the Echo context
Query the database for the workspace by slug; return HTTP 404 if not found
Verify the workspace's `org_id` matches an org with the given org slug; return HTTP 404 if mismatch (anti-enumeration)
Verify `clone_status = 'ready'`; return HTTP 404 with git pkt-line error format if not ready

subtasks.title: Implement authorization access control matrix enforcement
details: Create `internal/gitserver/authz.go` with an `authorizeGitOp(identity *Identity, workspace *Workspace, op string) error` function
For `op = "read"`: allow admin tokens (any workspace), owner API keys (own workspace), PATs with `git:read` or `git:write` (own workspace)
For `op = "write"`: allow admin tokens (any workspace), owner API keys (own workspace), PATs with `git:write` (own workspace); return HTTP 403 for `git:read`-only PATs
Non-owner, non-admin identities without matching scopes return HTTP 404 (anti-enumeration)
Wire `authorizeGitOp` into each handler after `resolveWorkspace`
